messages:
Alex Kim: Heads up — aggregate counts for feature_engagement `feature_x` are missing for 2026-03-20 02:00-06:00 UTC. Alert showed gaps on hourly-agg dashboard. Suspect late ingress from kafka consumer group `ingest-phi`
Maria Chen: Ack. I can see nulls in hourly_agg for those partitions. Question: targeted recompute vs full replay? quota/cost tradeoffs.
Jamal Patel: Prefer targeted recompute first. Full replay may double-count if upstream dedupe changed. Can we run a dry-run with diffs?
Sara Lopez: Console has a dry-run toggle but it only shows row counts today. UX ask: show a small diff preview + checksum before promoting.
Alex Kim: Proposal: canary recompute for 2 partitions in the window as dry-run diff. If checksum delta < 0.1% we promote to full run. Who can kick off the canary?
Jamal Patel: I can. Will call internal API `POST /recompute` with body `{"range":"2026-03-20T02:00:00Z/2026-03-20T06:00:00Z","partitions": [1234,1235],"dry_run":true}`
Sara Lopez: Please set `quota_scope=\"low-priority\"` and `cost_cap=200` on the job so it doesn't hit reserved capacity. Also we should surface estimated cost in the UI.
Maria Chen: Also remember KV cache impact — if we eventually promote, downstream caches need invalidation marker `invalidate:feature_x:20260320T02`. Add to checklist.
Alex Kim: Can the dry-run emit the invalidation keys as a preview so ops can verify?
Jamal Patel: Yup — I'll add `--emit-invalidation-preview` to the dry-run so it logs keys without applying them.
replay-bot: Job queued: recompute-dryrun-1718301234-1234 (status: queued)
Sara Lopez: I'll implement a lightweight diff modal in the console: top 5 changed rows, a checksum %, and estimated token/cost. Small UX change, low risk.
Maria Chen: Set a temporary SLO: 5m alerting for canary failures and auto-cancel remaining jobs on fail via routing policy.
Alex Kim: If canary passes, schedule full targeted recompute in off-peak with fair-share quota and post results to #eng-platform tagging owners.
Jamal Patel: Kicking off in ~10m. Will paste the curl and job id here once started.
replay-bot: Job started: recompute-dryrun-1718301234-1234 (status: running)
Jamal Patel: Curl snippet to run (internal): ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"range":"2026-03-20T02:00:00Z/2026-03-20T06:00:00Z","partitions":[1234,1235],"dry_run":true,"quota_scope":"low-priority","cost_cap":200}' https://internal-api.redwood/recompute
```
Alex Kim: :thumbsup: Keep logs and diffs posted. If diffs look weird we escalate and open a quick postmortem.
